title: Naye sheher mein koi nahi
banner:
Naya sheher, nayi naukri,
aur koi apna nahi 🌃
caption:
Anaya ke paas sab hai: naukri, kamra, chaar sau contacts. Bas raat ko baat karne ko koi nahi. 👇
Jahan anjaan log sach sunte hain: Waypoint, link in bio. 18+
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about moving to a new city with a new job, a rented room and four hundred contacts, and nobody to talk to at night. Waypoint is free on Google Play, for adults 18 and over.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Anaya: Anaya has long wavy black hair and warm brown eyes; as a grown woman her signature outfit is a lilac hoodie and blue jeans.
cast.fox: The fox mascot is a friendly small orange fox with big kind eyes and a teal scarf, standing on two legs like a storybook character.

scenes.vo: नया शहर, नई नौकरी, नया कमरा।
scenes.sub: Naya sheher, nayi naukri, naya kamra.
scenes.art: Anaya in a lilac hoodie steps out of an auto-rickshaw with a big suitcase in front of a tall apartment block in a big Indian city, looking up, morning haze, traffic around her.
Close view of Anaya's phone in her hand showing a long contact list scrolling past, her face reflected faintly in the dark screen, a small rented room behind.

scenes.vo: रात को, बात करने को कोई नहीं।
scenes.sub: Raat ko, baat karne ko koi nahi.

scenes.vo: पुरानी दोस्त से कहा, सब बढ़िया है यार।
scenes.sub: Purani dost se kaha, 'sab badhiya hai yaar.'

scenes.vo: घर पर कहा, बहुत मज़ा आ रहा है।
scenes.sub: Ghar par kaha, 'bahut maza aa raha hai.'

scenes.vo: और छत पर अकेले, सच कुछ और था।
scenes.sub: Aur chhat par akele, sach kuch aur tha.

scenes.vo: फिर एक जगह मिली, जहाँ कोई नहीं जानता, तुम कौन हो।
scenes.sub: Phir ek jagah mili, jahan koi nahi jaanta, tum kaun ho.

scenes.vo: वहाँ हज़ारों अनजान, अपना सच लिख रहे थे।
scenes.sub: Wahan hazaaron anjaan, apna sach likh rahe the.

scenes.vo: कोई नए शहर में अकेला। कोई नई नौकरी से डरा हुआ।
scenes.sub: Koi naye sheher mein akela. Koi nayi naukri se dara hua.
scenes.art: A night sky over a big city where glowing paper cards float above different lit windows, each window with a different young person reading their phone, warm and connected.

scenes.vo: मैंने भी लिखा। बिना नाम के।
scenes.sub: Maine bhi likha. Bina naam ke.

scenes.vo: और पहली बार, इस शहर में, किसी ने सुना।
scenes.sub: Aur pehli baar, is sheher mein, kisi ne suna.

scenes.vo: शहर वही है। बस अब, मैं अकेली नहीं।
scenes.sub: Sheher wahi hai. Bas ab, main akeli nahi.

scenes.vo: आपके शहर में, आपकी बात कौन सुनता है?
scenes.sub: Aapke sheher mein, aapki baat kaun sunta hai?
